title: Ukrainian Cheese Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish made with flaky pastry and melted cheese. Serve as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of pastry using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a dumpling in the center of each circle of pastry.
Fold the pastry over the dumpling to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges to seal.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with melted butter or egg wash.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the dumplings are baking, melt the gouda cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the dumplings are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot with the melted gouda cheese spooned over the top.
